summary: EAROS iteration 1: comprehensive backend (29 pytest cases) + frontend Playwright smoke across all 10 pages. 29/29 backend tests pass. All frontend pages render with expected data-testids; recruiter copilot end-to-end (job pick -> top candidate -> AI decision cards -> approve+execute -> EXECUTION RESULT), simulate-plan, planner, governance approvals+events, world-jobs (12 rows), policies (6 cards visible incl. all 5 policy-{id}), capabilities (7 cards), executive (strategy/skill-gap/org-health), candidate lookup (no salary leak), auth redirect all verified working. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Requires 'goal' field in body (not documented in the review-request test spec). Tests updated to include it. Not a bug — noting as minor spec-vs-code diff.

integration_issues.issue: AI Decision cards only render for candidates that appear in the top-5 planner ranking for the job (by design — non-top candidates show a fallback message). Not a bug, but worth flagging: earlier test iterations that click an arbitrary candidate row may falsely appear to fail — must pick a top-ranked candidate. Verified working when selecting a top-ranked candidate (cand_sfdc_lead_bangalore_11).

issues: Recharts warnings in console: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Chart still renders but the warning suggests a race between container mount and ResponsiveContainer measurement. Cosmetic only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Silence Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height=-1 warning on Hiring Dashboard (add explicit height or delay render until container measured).
OPTIONAL: Consider showing partial AI Decision info (or a Generate Recommendation button) for non-top-5 candidates in Recruiter Copilot to avoid confusion.
OPTIONAL: Document that /api/runtime/execute expects a 'goal' string field (review-request test spec omitted it).
critical_code_review_comments: Every capability execution emits POLICY_EVALUATED and runtime.step.* events — verified via /api/governance/events and UI event stream. Immutable event invariant holds.
cap.generate_offer always transitions to awaiting_approval per pol.offer_requires_approval — verified. LLM-cannot-bypass-policy invariant holds.
cap.advance_stage with confidence < 0.75 correctly gated to awaiting_approval per pol.min_confidence_advance — verified.
Reflection auto-generated after terminal executions — /api/reflection/reports returns non-empty list with what_happened + why fields.
Every AI recommendation carries reasoning[], evidence, confidence, tradeoffs, risks, policies_referenced — verified on hiring, offer, strategy endpoints.
Candidate-safe view /api/apps/candidate/{id}/status returns only public fields (full_name, stage) — no salary/compensation/internal_notes leaked.
Auth-gated pages redirect unauthenticated users to Landing (/) — verified by clearing session and hitting /dashboard.
Google OAuth /api/auth/session with invalid X-Session-ID returns 401 as expected; without header returns 422 (FastAPI validation) which is acceptable.
test_credentials: Dev login used demo.recruiter@levelshift.ai via POST /api/auth/dev-login (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: None. Bootstrap seed (/api/bootstrap) is idempotent and was pre-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_earos_backend.py (pytest, 29 tests, all passing). Runtime.execute requires goal field. Recruiter AI Decision cards only appear for top-5 planner ranked candidates for the selected job — pick candidate returned by GET /api/intelligence/hiring/{job_id} for E2E tests. Governance UI shows real pending approvals when offer/low-confidence executions occur. All EAROS invariants (LLM-cannot-bypass-policy, immutable events, auto-reflection) are working.
